gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-fs-epilogue: Baloo Thambi 2 puffs up its lowercase with a deep, friendly midsection. Epilogue sits below as a plain sans with curvy, wiry strokes, and it reads best at a generous body size so those stubby ascenders can breathe.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-fs-merriweather-sa: Merriweather Sans stands tall, its lowercase looking sturdy and large with an e that opens clearly to the right. Over a full page, Merriweather Sans keeps words easy to follow beneath the chubby, gap-toothed Baloo Thambi 2.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-fs-public-sans: Public Sans has a hefty lowercase and broad counters that make it feel trustworthy straight away. And the page moves along smoothly under Baloo Thambi 2, whose deep-bellied letters supply the personality while the body simply carries the text.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-fs-ranade: Ranade spreads its widely spaced letters out, with stroke ends far apart and weight that shifts only slightly, like stretched rubber cord. Baloo Thambi 2 is best at showing off; Ranade is best at flowing.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-fs-supreme: Baloo Thambi 2 brings expressive, deep-bellied lowercase with distinct gaps in its c, e and s, made for grabbing attention. But Supreme does the steady work, forming a thick, crisp band of text whose letters stay held open.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a big x-height and smooth curves, drawn with steady pressure and no swing between thick and thin. Baloo Thambi 2 brings the swagger above it.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-manrope: Manrope leaves a bright opening at the mouth of every curved letter, and its pen line holds one width throughout. Make the heading small or the body large, and the difference in character fades.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-montserrat: Montserrat glides under the eye like wire, with generous white space before each curve and oversized e and a counters. Its geometric precision against the squishy, deep-bodied Baloo Thambi 2 is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-satoshi: Baloo Thambi 2 has a deep, expressive midsection and distinct gaps in its c, e and s. Satoshi sits next to it feeling approachable and unfussy, with a soaring x-height and a wide-open e, every stroke cut to a single width.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-switzer: Baloo Thambi 2 swells through the lowercase with distinct gaps, expressive and a little cheeky next to its neighbor. Switzer runs on tubular, pencil-line letterforms and a tall waist line, so a long passage glides along.
